observations.why: The text carries competence as a performed value: calibration is not merely stated but verified against a reference standard, appealing to mastery and quality of craft.
Instrument identification alone carries a thin competence signal — naming the tool is part of the craft record — but no value language is appealed to beyond the label.
Verification against prior reference plates carries both competence (mastery validated against a standard) and conservation (holding to an established reference, keeping what works).
